transcript.content: Hello, thank you for coming in. Can you tell me what’s been troubling you or what brings you here today?

Um... hi. I guess things have just been a bit much lately. 

I've been trying to turn my art into, like, a real freelance business. But... I don't know, I just get really wound up over the invoices and client messages. So I end up just avoiding them. And then it just... I don't know. It gets bad, and I end up just crying at my kitchen table. Or I start forgetting normal stuff, like paying my own bills. 

So... yeah. I guess that's why I'm here.
Have you had times when you felt this way for most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?
Um... I don't know. Not really. It's not all day, every day. Just... mostly when the business stuff piles up, I guess.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about everyday things, even when there isn’t a clear reason for concern?
Um... no, not really. I mean, it's pretty much just the art stuff. If I don't have to deal with that, I'm... I'm mostly fine, I think.
Has this anxiety about your art business affected other areas of your life, like relationships, work, or daily responsibilities?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Like I mentioned, I end up... putting off client replies. And... well, home stuff, too, I guess. I missed a utility payment recently. I was just... trying to keep up with an art display, and the other stuff just sort of... slipped my mind. So, yeah.
Do you often find it hard to focus or stay organized even when you're not dealing with your art business, like in everyday tasks or hobbies?
Um... no, not really. If I'm not dealing with the business stuff, I can focus fine. I mean, I can still read or... do other things. It's just the art stuff that messes me up.
When you're feeling stressed about your art business, do you notice any physical symptoms like restlessness, being easily tired, or muscle tension?

Um... no, not really. I mean, my stomach might get a little tied up in knots if I'm looking at an email I don't want to answer, but... I don't think my muscles get tense or anything. I'm just... stressed.
Has the stress around your art business caused you to withdraw from friends, family, or activities you usually enjoy?
Um... I don't think so. I still see my friends and... do things. It's really just the business side of things that's hard right now.
Have you ever found it really hard to get started on tasks that aren't related to your art business, like chores or other responsibilities?
No, not really. I mean, chores are just chores. I do them when they need to be done. It's not... a big struggle or anything.

Outside of your art business, have you ever felt anxious or overwhelmed to the point where it interfered with your ability to function in other important areas of your life, like school, social activities, or family responsibilities?
No, I don't think so. I mean, my life outside of trying to sell my art is... fine. I handle everything else okay. It's just the business stuff that gets to me.
When you're dealing with stress outside of your art business, like a sudden problem with a friend or a difficult task at home, do you find it harder than usual to cope or feel unusually overwhelmed?
Um, no. I handle normal stuff fine. It's just... normal life. I deal with it.
Outside of your art business, have you ever had trouble managing your responsibilities at home, with friends, or in other roles because of feeling anxious or overwhelmed?
Um, no. Like I just said... I manage everything else fine. I don't really have issues keeping up with my friends or the house. It really is just the art stuff.
When you avoid dealing with invoices or client messages for your art business, is it because you feel so emotionally overwhelmed that you can't bring yourself to start or finish those tasks?

Yeah... I guess that's why I came in. Ever since I tried turning my art into a real freelance business, I just get really wound up over the invoices and client messages. I avoid them until... well, until I'm crying at the kitchen table. Or I end up forgetting normal stuff, like paying my own bills.
Outside of your art business, have you ever had trouble keeping up with your personal or professional responsibilities because of worry or stress?
I... didn't you just ask me that? Like I said, no. Outside of the art stuff, I handle things. I just... I don't know why we keep going over this part.

Outside of your art business, have you ever had difficulty performing your usual roles or responsibilities—like at home, with friends, or in other obligations—because of anxiety, worry, or feeling overwhelmed?
I... you literally just asked me this. Three times now. No. I don't have trouble with anything else. Just the art. Can we please move on?
Can you recall a time when managing your art business felt manageable, and if so, what was different about that time compared to now?
I don't really know. No... I don't think there was a time. Ever since I decided to try and make it an actual business, it's just... been like this. I can't really think of a time when it felt fine.

When you're dealing with client interactions for your art business, do you feel particularly anxious about being judged or evaluated by others, such as worrying they might think poorly of your work or your professionalism?

I mean... not really. I don't think about them judging me, if that's what you mean. It's just... the whole thing is stressful. But no, I don't really sit around worrying about them thinking I'm unprofessional or whatever.
Are you only anxious or overwhelmed in situations where you feel like you're being evaluated or need to perform, like presenting your art or discussing business details?
No... I don't think it's about performing. Like I just said, it's not really about being evaluated. It's just... the business side of it. That's all.

Is the stress you feel around your art business limited to specific situations, like meeting deadlines or handling client expectations, or does it seem to affect you more generally when you're dealing with anything related to the business?

I'm not really sure... I haven't really broken it down like that. I guess it's just... all of it. Whenever I have to deal with the business side of things, it just gets to me. I don't really know if it's worse during certain parts or not.

When you feel anxious about your art business, is it mostly in situations where you have to take action right away, like sending an invoice or responding to a client, or does the anxiety stick around even when there’s no immediate task to handle?

I don't really know... I guess it just kind of sticks around. I haven't really noticed if it's only when I have a specific task to do right that second. It's just... always kind of stressful to think about.
